mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_project_conversation_expert_session (id, tenant_id, project_id, conversation_id, expert_id, session_id, message_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{conversationId}, #{expertId}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id = VALUES(session_id), message_id = VALUES(message_id)
